data.projectReference: BBI-2401 / Strawberry Fields / Fleet Depot Expansion
entries: 06:45 — Toolbox talk: trench access and spotter requirements. Six electricians, one operator and one foreman checked in.
08:00 — West service room rough-in continued per E-201. Panel delivery checked; one carton of bonding bushings short. Procurement notified.

10:50 — Utility requested charger island relocation due to transformer clearance. Crew shifted trench alignment east and installed approximately 70 additional feet of conduit. Two electricians and one operator remained onsite until 5:30 PM. See RFI-042 and E-104 Rev C. Track these hours separately from the west service room work.
14:15 — Grounding electrode inspection passed for the maintenance building. Inspector requested updated as-built photos for the next visit.
17:45 — Trenches barricaded, stockpile covered, and equipment secured. No injuries or near misses. Tomorrow: continue conduit terminations and backfill after inspection.

quantities.measurementBasis: Preliminary tape measure along east reroute; final installed takeoff pending.

data.crewNote: Two electricians and one operator were assigned to the island reroute after utility direction. Final timecard coding is pending.
